EmailTemplate.subject: Scholar Day registration confirmation
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in Arizona State University! As requested, you and 0 guest(s) are registered to attend Scholar Day at ASU's Polytechnic campus on Thursday, Nov. 12 at 10:30 a.m. We look forward to welcoming you to our beautiful campus.
The day is structured to provide you with a comprehensive overview of ASU. You will have many opportunities to ask all your questions and have personal conversations with ASU staff and students regarding all aspects of becoming a Sun Devil.
Scholar Day Arizona State University, Polytechnic campus Administration Building Check-in: 10 a.m. Program: 10:30 a.m. – 4 p.m.
View a campus map for the location of the Administration Building at http://asu.edu/map/pdf/asu_map_poly_2013.pdf.
Parking and Directions Allow 30 minutes to park and check-in for your campus visit. Park in the visitor section of Lot 30, located off Innovation Way West. Parking passes will be given at check-in. Please observe and obey all of ASU's posted parking regulations. Visit the ASU Parking and Transit Services website for all parking options and driving directions for the Polytechnic campus. http://cfo.asu.edu/pts-visitor-polytechnic
For more information, please visit the Parking and Transit Services website or call 480-727-2775.
Accommodations For accommodations or information about hotels and attractions in the area, please contact the Mesa Convention and Visitors Bureau at 877-283-6372 or check out https://visitmesa.com. You can also find more information at https://visit.asu.edu/travel.
If you have questions regarding Scholar Day or need to make changes to your scheduled visit, please call 480-727-1536. We look forward to meeting you!
Sincerely,
Liz Hill Program Coordinator Campus Visits and Events Admission Services
If you would like any additional information or have questions related to this subject, please reply to this email.
